# 판정: 기호주의 검증 draft (대표 지시 발동) — 에이 편집용 hst_AAA §5.2 lem:doeblin 의 Claim 6·7·8·9·10·Assembly proof 를 한글 + 화살표 골격(⟹/⟺). 원본 07-06 02:48 재구성본 기준. 최종본 아님(승인 후 산문화 대상).

*기호주의 모드(대표 지시). 함의·근거를 전부 화살표(⟹/⟺) 골격으로 노출. 산문화는 검증·승인 후. 원본: 에이 **편집용** hst_AAA.tex §5.2 (07-06 02:48 재구성본).*

기호(Claim 1~5): 낙하벡터 $\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL}$, fall map $\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}$·유사역 $(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}$·커널기저 $\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}$, fall shift $\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}$, 자유좌표 $\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$, Jacobian $J$, slice floor $m_0$ [Claim 5], chamber $\mathsf{U}$, $s^{\star}\in\mathsf{C}_0$. 비교 $\mathsf{A}=\{a=(i,j,\rho)\}$, 계수 $\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\in\{0,\pm1\}^{nL}$ **fall order(시간순)** — $\rho'$번째 성분 = $\rho'$번째 낙하($\rho'\le\rho$이고 $v_i$면 $+1$·$v_j$면 $-1$, 아니면 $0$), gap $=\Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star}))+\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}$.

## Claim 6 (branch pick floor)

**진술.** $\mathbf{b}^{\flat}=\mathbf{0}$·cyclic schedule 조건. 모든 비교가 **resolved**(strictly-lower 결과가 event 위 상수; exact tie = "not strictly lower" 결정론)인 event 위 ⟹ resolved pattern이 매 flow step의 strictly-lower set 결정 ⟹ pattern 일치 branch $\amalg$ 를 walker 가 확률 $\ge(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}$ 로 실현.

**증명.**

$$
\text{매 step move law} = \text{strictly-lower 이웃 위}\ (\text{resolved outcome})
$$
$$
\text{각 라운드 strictly-decreasing path } \le n-1\ \text{flows} < (\ge n\ \text{허용}) \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{threshold 안 binding} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{itinerary feasible}
$$
$$
\le nL(n-1)\ \text{flow step (다중 strictly-lower)},\ \text{각 degree-weighted pick atom} \ge 1/n^2 \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{곱} \ge (1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 7 (fiber / 퇴화 dichotomy / tie-tube)

**진술.** fiber $\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}=(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$ ⟹ 각 gap $\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$의 아핀, 기울기 $(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a$. 퇴화 = 기울기 $\mathbf{0}$(fiber 상수), 비퇴화 $\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}:=\{a:(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\ne\mathbf{0}\}$. **row-space obs**: $\operatorname{Range}((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{\top})=\{$노드그룹 상수, 그룹합 $0\}$. $\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}:=\min_{i\ne j}\inf_{\mathbf{u}\in\overline{\mathsf{U}}}|\Delta_{ij}(\mathbf{u})|>0$. 아래 (I)(II).

**(I) 퇴화 dichotomy.**

$$
(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\perp\ker\mathbf{A}^{\sharp} \;\Longleftrightarrow\; \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\in\operatorname{Range}((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{\top}) \overset{\text{row-space}}{=\!=\!=} \{\text{노드그룹 상수, 합}=0\}
$$
$$
+\ \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\ (v_i\text{군}\,{+1}\,/\,v_j\text{군}\,{-1}\,/\,\text{else}\,0) \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{각 노드 all-or-none} \;\Longrightarrow\; \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0}\ (\text{fall 무관, Claim 9 regionwise 처리})\ \ \text{또는}\ \ \text{final-equality}
$$
$$
\text{final-equality}: \Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star}))+\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}=\Delta_{ij}(\mathbf{u}) \;\Longrightarrow\; |\Delta_{ij}(\mathbf{u})|\ge\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}\ (\ast).\ \blacksquare
$$

**(II) tie-tube.** (목표: $\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL},\ \min_{a\in\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}}|\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}+\Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}})|\le\delta\}\bigr|\le C_{\mathrm{tie}}\delta$.)

$$
\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}\ \text{유한} \Rightarrow \lambda_\ast:=\min_{\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}}\|(\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\|>0;\quad \text{비교} = \mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\text{-아핀, 기울기}\ (\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a,\ \|\cdot\|\ge\lambda_\ast
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; \{|\cdot|\le\delta\}\ \text{길이}\le 2\delta/\lambda_\ast,\ \text{slice 지름}\le b\sqrt{nL} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{유계단면 적분}+\text{유한합}\le C_{\mathrm{tie}}\delta.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 8 (경계 cost / robust core)

**(I) 경계.** (목표: $\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL},\ \min_j b^{\sharp}_j\le\delta\ \text{or}\ \min_j(b-b^{\sharp}_j)\le\delta\}\bigr|\le C_{\mathrm{bdry}}\delta$.)

$$
\text{면}\ \{b^{\sharp}_j=0/b\}:\ \text{아핀}\ \mathbf{e}_j\cdot((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{a}^{\sharp}+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}),\ (\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp})^{\top}\mathbf{e}_j\ne\mathbf{0}\ (\because\ \text{아니면}\ \mathbf{e}_j\in\operatorname{Range}((\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{\top}),\ \text{row-space 모순})
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; \text{같은 slicing},\ 2nL\ \text{면} \;\Longrightarrow\; \le C_{\mathrm{bdry}}\delta.\ \blacksquare
$$

**(II) robust core.** $(C_{\mathrm{tie}}+C_{\mathrm{bdry}})\delta\le m_0/2,\ \delta\le\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}$ 조건 하:
$$
\mathsf{R}_\delta(s^{\star}):=\{\delta\le b^{\sharp}_j\le b-\delta\ \forall j\}\cap\bigcap_{a\in\mathsf{A}_{\mathrm{nd}}}\{|\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a\cdot\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}+\Delta_{ij}(\mathring{\mathbf{h}})|\ge\delta\}
$$
$$
\text{전체 slice}=m_0\ [\text{Claim 5}],\ \text{도려낸 tube}\le(C_{\mathrm{tie}}+C_{\mathrm{bdry}})\delta\le m_0/2\ [\text{Claim 7(II)}+(\text{I})] \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{잔존}\ge m_0/2=:m_\ast
$$
$$
\text{core 위: 비퇴화}\ge\delta,\ \text{final-equality no tie}\ [\text{Claim 7(I)}],\ \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0}\ \text{상수(no cut)} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{fall-side pattern well-defined} \;\Longrightarrow\; \mathsf{R}_\delta=\textstyle\bigsqcup_{\amalg}\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 9 (transport — off $\mathbf{b}^{\flat}=\mathbf{0}$ branch 유지)

**진술.** $\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\in[0,\varepsilon]^{nLT_{\max}},\ \mathbf{u}\in\mathsf{U},\ \amalg$ ⟹ slice $\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}(\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}})+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}\}$의 모든 $\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}$가 $(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}(\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}}-\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat})+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL}$·branch $\amalg$ 실현.

**증명.** (목표: 모든 비교를 margin 절반 미만으로만 움직이면 됨.)

$$
\text{단일}\ \Gamma<\infty:\ \{\|\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\|,\ \|(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\|,\ \text{비교의}\ \mathbf{b}^{\flat}\text{-감도}\}\le\Gamma\varepsilon;\quad \varepsilon\le\min\{b/(8nT_{\max}),\ \delta/(4\Gamma),\ \kappa_{\mathsf{U}}/(4\Gamma)\}
$$
$$
\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\mapsto\widehat{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}:=\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}-(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat} \;\Longrightarrow\; \mathbf{A}^{\sharp}\widehat{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}=\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}}-\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat};\ (\dagger)\ \text{좌표로}\ \mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\ \textbf{불변}\ (\text{target만 이동})
$$
$$
\text{shift}\le\Gamma\varepsilon\le\delta/4 \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{비퇴화}\ \le\delta/2\ \text{이동, 부호 유지};\quad \text{final-equality}\ \ge\kappa_{\mathsf{U}}/2\ [\text{Claim 7(I)}]
$$
$$
\boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0}:\ \text{fall 무관} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{transport 안 움직임},\ \text{outcome}=(s^{\star},\mathbf{b}^{\flat})\ \text{함수·region 상수},\ \amalg\ \text{가 그 region 일치로 선택}
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; \widehat{\mathbf{b}}^{\sharp}\in[0,b]^{nL}\cdot\text{branch}\ \amalg\ \text{유지} \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{slice 측도}\ge\text{원래, uniform in}\ \mathbf{b}^{\flat}.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Claim 10 (discrete scaffold)

**진술.** $\forall s^{\star}\in\mathsf{C}_0$ branch pin 가능·uniform floor: cyclic schedule + non-fall $\le\varepsilon$ + fall $\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}$($\mathbf{b}^{\flat}$ region 일치, Claim 9) 조건 ⟹ walker $\amalg$ 실현 $\ge(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}$; 두 조건 event $\ge\mu_{\min}^{nL},\ (\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}$ ⟹ scaffold $\le\mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}(\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}$.

**증명.**

$$
\text{cyclic schedule}\ (\textstyle\prod_i\boldsymbol{\mu}_0(v_i))^L\ge\mu_{\min}^{nL}\ [\text{iid}\ \boldsymbol{\mu}_0,\ \text{snowfall A}];\quad \text{non-fall smallness}\ge(\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}\ [\text{step당}\ \varepsilon/b]
$$
$$
\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}\ \text{위 fall-dependent 비교 strictly signed}\ [\text{Claim 8(II)}] + \boldsymbol{\alpha}_a=\mathbf{0}\ \text{non-fall region 상수 resolved}\ [\text{Claim 9}] \;\Longrightarrow\; \text{모든 비교 resolved}
$$
$$
\overset{\text{Claim 6}}{\Longrightarrow} \text{walker}\ \amalg\ \ge(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)},\ \text{uniform in}\ s^{\star}.\ \blacksquare
$$

## Assembly

**목표.** $(P^{\star})^{nL}(s^{\star},\mathsf{B}\times\{v_n\})\ge\eta\,|\mathsf{B}|/|\mathsf{U}|$ ⟹ $\mathsf{C}_0$ small.

$$
\text{endpoint}=\text{terminal fall}\ (X_{t_{r+nL}}=v_n,\ \text{no subsequent flow});\quad \mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star})\longmapsto\mathring{\mathbf{h}}(s^{\star})+\mathbf{A}^{\sharp}\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}+\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat}\ (\text{후자 Claim 9로 branch pin})
$$

scenario suffices: $\mathsf{U}$ 안착 [Claim 3(I)(II)] $\wedge$ branch $\amalg$ uniform floor [Claim 10] $\wedge$ fall density floor [Claim 4] $\wedge$ non-fall 안 깸 [Claim 9]. scenario: cyclic falls(terminal $v_n$) + $\amalg$($\mathbf{b}^{\flat}$ 고정) + $\mathbf{b}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}$ + non-fall $\le\varepsilon$ ⟹ walker $\to v_n$, 높이$\in\mathsf{B}$ ⟺ $\mathsf{G}_{\mathsf{B}}$.

$$
\rho_{\mathbf{b}^{\flat}}(\mathbf{u})=\tfrac{J}{b^{nL}}\sum_{\amalg}\bigl|\{\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}:(\mathbf{A}^{\sharp})^{+}(\mathbf{u}-\mathring{\mathbf{h}}-\mathbf{A}^{\flat}_{\amalg}\mathbf{b}^{\flat})+\mathbf{Z}^{\sharp}\mathbf{z}^{\sharp}\in\mathsf{R}_{\delta,\amalg}\}\bigr| \overset{\text{Claim 8,9}}{\ge} m_\ast J/b^{nL}=:c_\ast>0\ \text{on}\ \mathsf{U}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
(P^{\star})^{nL}(s^{\star},\mathsf{B}\times\{v_n\})
&\ge \mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}\!\int_{[0,\varepsilon]^{nLT_{\max}}}\! b^{-nLT_{\max}}\!\int_{\mathsf{B}}\rho_{\mathbf{b}^{\flat}}(\mathbf{u})\,d\mathbf{u}\,d\mathbf{b}^{\flat} &&(\because\mathsf{G}_{\mathsf{B}},\ \text{Claim 10})\\
&\ge \mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}(\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}c_\ast|\mathsf{B}| &&(\because\rho\ge c_\ast,\ \textstyle\int\mathbf{b}^{\flat})\\
&= \eta\,|\mathsf{B}|/|\mathsf{U}| &&(\eta:=\mu_{\min}^{nL}(1/n)^{2nL(n-1)}(\varepsilon/b)^{nLT_{\max}}c_\ast|\mathsf{U}|>0)
\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\;\Longrightarrow\; (P^{\star})^{nL}(s^{\star},\cdot)\ge\eta\,\nu,\ \ \nu=\mathrm{Unif}(\mathsf{U})\otimes\delta_{v_n} \;\Longrightarrow\; \mathsf{C}_0\ \text{small}.\ \blacksquare
$$

**Snowfall A 필수.** 각 낙하 Lebesgue 밀도 ⟹ fall density floor. Snowfall B ⟹ 라운드 상수 ⟹ $nL$ 좌표가 라운드당 스칼라로 붕괴 ⟹ image Lebesgue-null in $\mathbb{R}^{n-1}$ ⟹ floor 실패.
